purpose: Bounded programmatic read-only scan of both observed Keenetic radios.

official_source.title: Keenetic Giga III CLI Command Reference, show site-survey
official_source.scope_note: The manual documents show site-survey <name> as displaying available wireless networks without changing settings; it lists WifiMaster0 and WifiMaster1 as radio choices. This is syntax evidence, not a claim that results are timestamped or interruption-free on the target build.

impact_preflight.management_link: Wi-Fi; virtual route inspection found router reply path outside candidate VPNs, but local management is not wired.
impact_preflight.radio_risk: A survey can briefly disrupt traffic on the radio being surveyed. WifiMaster1 currently carries the connected WISP station and local access point on the same-band radio.
impact_preflight.controls: Run WifiMaster0 first, then WifiMaster1 only if command exit is zero and before/after status is readable. Use 20-second command timeout, SSH keepalives, no retry loop. Stop on nonzero/timeout/status loss; preserve failed attempt and coordinate one readback if needed.

output_policy: Keep only radio band, complete result count, exact target SSID match boolean and target channel/quality, sanitized master/AP/station states, command status, timestamps and hashes. Never persist raw output, unrelated SSIDs, BSSIDs/MACs, addresses or secrets.
freshness_policy: Record whether the command response provides per-result timestamps. If none, mark freshness unconfirmed; do not claim fresh scan results.
